description: Flattened list of publishable tool returns. One record per tool-return message in a publishable run.

record.message_index: integer, 0-based index inside the run's messages array
record.tool_name: string, the name carried by the tool message
record.content: string holding the tool return exactly as captured in the source run

example_note: The example is illustrative and is not part of the captured set.
